references.text: Moses received instructions to take blood from the altar and sprinkle it on Aaron and his sons and their garments to consecrate them for priestly service.
Describes the holy anointing oil that Moses used to consecrate Aaron and his sons.
God's command to anoint Aaron and his sons to consecrate them for priestly service.
Moses poured anointing oil on Aaron's head to consecrate him, which is part of the same inauguration ceremony.
Refers to the anointing oil from the Lord that was upon the priests and warns against leaving the sanctuary.
The high priest who has received anointing oil poured over his entire head and is consecrated to wear the priestly garments.
Moses sprinkled blood on the tabernacle and all the vessels used in worship, pointing back to the consecration of the priests and the sanctuary.
